name: HomeschoolCompliance Pack
tagline: Your state's homeschool deadlines and forms, done in 10 minutes.
description: Parent selects their state; gets a pre-filled notice-of-intent template, a personal calendar of every required filing/testing date for the year, and email reminders 2 weeks out.
ethics_concerns: Core value is authoritative, state-specific statutory data (filing/testing deadlines, notice-of-intent templates) that amend independently — Lens 6 fully triggered
A stale rule or outdated template directly risks a family's legal standing and a child's schooling
